reviews.author: Jayakumar S
reviews.text: AccuMed Specialities and Scans is a top-notch clinic, easily accessible from the areas of Porur and Valsaravakkam. Dr. Aishwarya and Dr. Ashwin are down-to-earth professionals who provide exceptional consultation and treatment. They treat patients with the same care and attention as they would their own family, fostering a deep sense of trust. The clinic is fully equipped with scans, blood tests, and other fertility tests, eliminating the need for patients to visit multiple locations. Additionally, the in-house pharmacy adds to the convenience, making AccuMed a one-stop solution for all healthcare needs

reviews.author: Madhula Sathyamoorthy
reviews.text: Dr. Aishwarya and Dr. Ashwin, both are very professional and friendly. They made our entire pregnancy journey (medication, scans and delivery) smooth and safe. Since we liked their approach so much, we travelled all the way from one end of the city to the other end to consult them.

reviews.author: Dhivya Ramalingam
reviews.text:
I was looking for cervavac (HPV) vaccine in chennai. All major hospitals had the other non Indian brand, thanks to Aishwarya mam for posting awareness video on HPV vaccination and about availability of cervavac.
About the clinic, very clean and a good ambience. Aishwarya mam stopped by while I was waiting. She greeted patients with a warm smile, was down to earth, unlike other doctors..

reviews.author: Srividya V
reviews.text:
I was really overwelmed by the way Dr.aishwarya maam treated and guided us over the pregnancy journey.  with all natural processes. Everyone in the family was very happy that the normal delivery was possible with all your support and guidance. It has become hard to hear normal deliveries nowadays. It was possible for us with your support and guidance. And your guidance have motivated me to do all the household work or sitting down, being active to the extent possible. To be frank with that confidence i was even cleaning the bathroom and sitting on the floor even on the morning when the contraction started. Your natural process of keeping things simple boosted my confidence to be active. Thanks again for your support in building our family.

And Dr. Ashwin sir, showed us the pregnancy scans in a very patient way and showed ud the baby in detail. We could feel the difference of scanning by Dr. Ashwin when compared to other scanning centre. The 3D scan he showed us which revealed the face of baby was really heart touching and gave us a great feel and memory. Thanks to Dr. Ashwin

reviews.author: Michael Dinesh
reviews.text: I usually judge the knowledge and the expertise of a doctor based on their experience.But, Dr.Aishwarya proved this wrong to me. She has a very strong expertise in the field of O&G. Also, she strongly believes "One Size doesn't fit all", she customize her treatment based on the patient's health and history. We are lucky to have her as our doctor!!

reviews.author: baby shree
reviews.text: Dr.Aishwarya is the best gyneac in the city ! The way she handles paitents is really awesome..I am consulting her for my second pregnancy..She is always fine with doubts from our side..even if it's silly she answers with patience..I strongly recommend her for the fertility and pregnancy related treatments..

reviews.author: Padmavathy Udayakumar
reviews.text: I had fibroid issue and meet Dr Aishwarya in her clinic. She checked and reports and clarified my doubts. She handles the patients very good and politely.

reviews.author: preethi Seshadri
reviews.text: Very serene atmosphere and good care taken by Dr.Aishwarya and the staff. Soft approach to the patient especially with younger generation to make them understand in the right way. Sophisticated technology with all facilities under one roof. Dr.Aishwarya the best choice for women!

reviews.author: Padmashri Sri
reviews.text: Highly skilled gynecologist, it is a  recommended place to consult for all gynec and fertility related issues. You will definitely find a positive change in your life after visiting the clinic.

reviews.author: Nivedha Sampath
reviews.text: Went to clinic on seeing positive reviews and hype but disappointed.Extremely high waiting time and seating is uncomfortable can't accomodate crowd,more organization is needed as patients will feel suffocated.After waiting for 2 hrs I got consultation of 2 mins,doctor was bit rude when asked queries on my health issues,she rushed me up to leave the place for next patient.Not recommended if u want peaceful and good consultation.
